Good Morning Rama,

Apologies for the delay. The rate for extending your stay for the next month would be AED 7,500 for 30 nights.

Please note that our rates are dynamic and have increased due to the current market conditions. Therefore, this is the best rate we are able to offer at the moment.

Kindly let us know if you would like to proceed with the extension.

Thank you for your understanding.
